glyph.title: VFJ glyph payload for set_glyph
notes: This is the glyph object, not a font document or {glyph:...} wrapper. Use full get_glyph output as the edit base; construction summaries use different names and cannot be written.

set_glyph replaces all layers and modeled glyph metadata. Target name remains glyph_name; omitted writable fields reset to native defaults. Session timestamps and transient UI state are not an editing contract.
For new glyphs, provide name and at least one named layer with advanceWidth. New layers should match font master names. Auto layers (flags bit 16) may regenerate from autoRecipe.
Object labels/references are local to the payload. Copy all definitions needed by referenced elements/contours. No external files or URLs are resolved by schema discovery.

JSON Schema checks structure; native parsing additionally checks the format. Successful parsing does not prove component dependencies, rendering, expressions, or font-wide consistency. Inspect readback after committing.

layer.title: Glyph layer
notes: Layer coordinates are font units. Layer name matching matters for component sources and masters.
Prefer edit_layer_hints, set_glyph_anchors and set_glyph_metrics for small focused edits. Full replacement preserves only supplied layers.

element.title: Positioned element in a layer or group
notes: Choose component or elementData as content. Element transforms act on the content; contour tx is separate.
Shared elementData/transform/contour objects may use string labels or {$ref:...}; preserve exported representation (see references).

element_data.title: Element geometry and nested construction
notes: Outlines are under elementData.contours, not directly under an element.
Groups contain composite.includes, each an element. Components can be directly on an element or inside elementData.
get_glyph emits embedded PNG data for portable replacement. Do not invent imageId references.

component.title: Glyph component reference
notes: Do not put transform inside component. Placement belongs to its enclosing element.
Avoid self references and dependency cycles; refer to existing source glyphs/layers. Native parse validation alone does not establish dependency correctness.

transform.title: Affine or projective transformation object
notes: Affine: x′=xScale*x+yxScale*y+xOffset; y′=xyScale*x+yScale*y+yOffset.
The six-number construction summary [a,b,c,d,tx,ty] maps to xScale,xyScale,yxScale,yScale,xOffset,yOffset. It is not the writable VFJ representation.

Omit transform for identity. For projective matrices, divide affine numerators by xzScale*x+yzScale*y+zzScale. Preserve exported projective values; all-three-equal-1 is treated as the legacy affine sentinel.
Native serialization uses 8-decimal transform precision.

contour.title: Contour and node sequence
notes: Cubic segments have two curve handles between on-curve endpoints. Quadratic controls use off. Node indices are storage order; index in nodes_list is informational, not an insertion target.
Full VFJ import is more permissive than edit_glyph_nodes. Malformed contours may be normalized by the reader; inspect readback.

node.title: Explicit nodes_list entry
notes: Coordinates and flags belong to this node, not the enclosing element. Node types and aliases follow nodeTypeFromString.

node_properties.title: Contour node properties
notes: Other keys are decimal node indices mapping to dictionaries of native stroke/corner attributes. Preserve unrecognized attributes.

anchor.title: Anchor or element-local pinpoint
notes: Omitted point is the origin. Layer anchors are made anchors by their containing array.
Use set_glyph_anchors for independent cloud/mark settings; VFJ can encode differing cloud and mark states in flags.

guideline.title: Guidelines, stem/ghost hints and legacy zones
notes: center is an absolute point; vector is a relative direction. Axis flags with position are a compact representation.
Native linked node geometry and expressions can override explicit positions. Prefer edit_layer_hints with detach=true when intentionally breaking those links.

node_link.title: Persistent node link
notes: contour and linked objects may be native label references. Preserve identity relationships. Node index must exist in the referenced contour.

vector_node.title: Linked guideline node wrapper
notes: One nested node object is read by the native wrapper; preserve its objectType. For plain unlinked coordinates use guideline.center and guideline.vector.

composite.title: Group or live construction
notes: Without builder, a composite is a group. Live builders may regenerate contours from included elements.

image.title: Embedded raster image
notes: Use embedded image.PNG for standalone replacement. SVG is the elementData.svg string instead.

sticker.title: Annotation sticker
notes: Preserve exported arrow records; text stickers and arrow stickers use different subsets.

brush.title: Fill brush
notes: Native parser falls back to solid color for unsupported styles.

pen.title: Element outline pen
notes: For editable expanded stroke behavior use element.stroke.

stroke.title: Expanded stroke parameters
notes: Keep stroke properties consistent with element.pen. Unspecified values use native PenParameters defaults.

gradient.title: Gradient paint dictionary
notes: Gradient points use {x,y}, unlike the space-separated coordinate strings in native model objects.

tt_data.title: Raw TrueType glyph data
notes: Low-level TrueType program data. Prefer tth command strings for portable instruction edits; preserve raw arrays when round-tripping.

sigma.title: Sigma glyph metadata
notes: Native version-1 Sigma links model nonlinear interpolation corrections. Preserve extensions and malformed-data retention envelopes. Evaluation additionally requires compatible masters and resolvable node identities.

builder.title: Native live shape builder
notes: Exactly one builder kind normally appears. Includes belong to the enclosing composite, not the builder. Retain builder-specific data when editing unrelated geometry.

builderMerger.title: Merge included shapes.

graph.title: Native fill graph
notes: Graph edges/routes and reference identities are native construction data.

reference.title: Native shared object reference
notes: Native object definitions have id (or legacy label); references are label strings or {"href":"label"}. JSON Schema $ref is not a VFJ data field. Preserve the full reference graph.

overview.title: Writable VFJ glyph construction
notes: Read get_glyph without detail=construction, discover the needed schema topic, preserve unrelated fields, validate with set_glyph(dry_run=true), commit with the same arguments minus dry_run, then read back.

The catalog covers the complete glyph construction hierarchy, including advanced native data and extensible metadata. JSON Schema is structural documentation; native semantics and application state are separate.
Empty parameter objects on parameter-free builders are intentional. Legacy/session fields are documented but not recommended for new portable payloads.
The embedded chat accepts glyph_data up to 262144 UTF-16 code units. External MCP has no corresponding chat-only limit.

mesh.title: Mesh deformation program
notes: Rows and columns contain sequences of curves, each holding control points. Preserve topology when editing positions.

skin_element.title: Skin/brush element
notes: This variant dictionary uses a SIX-NUMBER transform array [m11,m12,m21,m22,dx,dy], unlike ordinary element.transform.

glue_parameters.title: Glued element parameters
notes: Other keys are decimal connection indices; each value holds conn_front and conn_back native connection enums.

property.title: Native expression property
notes: Scalar properties use value/expression. Point properties use exprX/exprY/paramType/valuePointF. Prefer anchor.exprX/exprY for new anchor expressions.

linked_node.title: Polymorphic linked node
notes: Native reader selects the subtype using objectType or enclosing field. References must resolve inside the supplied glyph.

state.title: Automatic detector state
notes: Native saved detector state. Preserve the supplied versioned state during construction edits.

expression.title: Native expression object
notes: Prefer explicit exprX/exprY fields for point expressions.

sigma_link.title: Sigma interpolation link
notes: from and to must differ. Cubic links require control2; quadratic links use control1. Controls are offsets in font units.
